workflow_runs.display_title: Standardize context fragment handling

head_commit.message:
refactor(core): unify contextual-user fragment detection via typed registry

Remove the standalone contextual-user marker list and switch detection to a
single typed detector registry in model_visible_context.

Add ContextualUserFragmentDetector and TaggedContextualUserFragment so
contextual-user fragments can declare detection behavior directly, then
register those fragment types in one canonical detector list used by
history parsing.

Update EnvironmentContext, skill/plugin instructions, user-shell command,
and turn-aborted markers to use the new tagged detector path, with AGENTS
keeping custom dynamic matching via ContextualUserFragmentDetector.

Update docs and AGENTS guidance to describe the new blessed detection path.

Co-authored-by: Codex <noreply@openai.com>

head_commit.message:
docs(core): clarify TurnContextDiffFragment baseline semantics

Expand trait docs to explicitly describe reference_context_item as the
already model-visible baseline snapshot and call out expected diff
suppression behavior when state is unchanged.

Also clarify the None-baseline cases (initial assembly and
compaction/backtracking/resume recovery) and expected fragment behavior.
